signIn.metaDescription: Sign in to save shortlists, notes and searches.
signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: An account is needed only to save your own work. Searching, player profiles and similarity stay open to everyone.
signIn.passwordChanged: Your password was changed and every session was ended. Sign in with the new one.

register.metaDescription: Create an account to save shortlists, notes and searches.
register.title: Create an account
register.description: Only to hold your own shortlists and notes. Nothing you can already read requires one.
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Length is what matters — a passphrase of ordinary words is stronger than a short one with symbols.

account.description: Your sign-in details and active sessions. Nothing here is shared with anyone else.
account.changeDescription: Changing it ends every session, including this one.
account.sessionsDescription: A session lasts 14 days, or 7 days without activity, whichever comes first.
account.sessionsBody: If you signed in somewhere you no longer control — a shared machine, a device you have lost — end every session. You will be signed out here too and can sign back in.

errors.auth_missing_registration: Enter an email address and a password.
errors.auth_passwords_differ: The two passwords do not match.
errors.auth_missing_change: Enter your current password and a new one.
errors.auth_new_passwords_differ: The two new passwords do not match.
errors.auth_session_ended: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.auth_unavailable: The service is unavailable right now.
errors.auth_generic_failure: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.auth_email_taken: An account with that email already exists.
errors.auth_password_too_short: Password must be at least {length} characters.
errors.auth_password_too_long: Password must be at most {length} characters.
